originalEntry.title: Product-focused motion graphics video template
originalEntry.title_zh: 聚焦产品的动效视频模板
originalEntry.author: ann_nnng
originalEntry.description: A 15-second motion graphics video about your product: Opus first visits the product pages, then writes the video content itself. Made in Claude Code.
originalEntry.description_zh: 围绕你的产品做 15 秒动效视频：Opus 先去看产品页面，再自己写视频内容。作者用的是 Claude Code。
originalEntry.prompt: Make a dynamic 15-second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are. The content should focus on [your product]. You should visit the pages first to learn about the product, then write the video content yourself.
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 制作一段 15 秒、充满动感的动态图形视频，展示你是多么出色的动效设计师。内容要聚焦在 [你的产品] 上。你应该先访问相关页面了解这个产品，然后自己写视频内容。
originalEntry.note: Author: one prompt, almost an hour.
originalEntry.note_zh: 作者称一条提示词，跑了将近一小时。
